```csharp
public enum PoseBakeChannelKind
```

What a single bake channel ([PoseBakeChannel](../pose-bake-channel/)) drives. The kind decides which values `PoseBakeChannel.CreateForBake` allocates.

## Values

| Name | Value | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `CameraPose` | `0` | A camera pose. Holds position, rotation, camera distance, look-at offset, look-at target index, field of view and clip range. Played back by [PoseBakeTrack](../pose-bake-track/). |
| `LightRotation` | `1` | The main light pose. Holds rotation, light intensity and color, with no position (the shading of a Directional Light depends only on its direction). Played back by [LightBakeTrack](../light-bake-track/). |
